name: web-full-landing-page-crop-with-circled-word-and-floating-ui-cards
title: Travel Landing Hero with Floating Info Cards
whatItIs: A dark slate slide titled Full Landing Page with a plane progress bar, and a lavender travel landing page with a nav and Login and Signup buttons, a headline 'Explore The World Your Way' with a circled word and small photo pills, store download buttons, and a centred phone surrounded by floating cards for passengers, flight details and stats.
whatItMeans: Floating info cards around a central phone show the product's range, and small photo pills in the headline add life.
techniques: Circled word and inline photo pills in the headline
Floating cards around a centre phone
Dark and light store buttons side by side

vocabulary.definition: A small rounded photo placed inline in a headline.
A card of interface detail floating near a device.
